text:
alex: Quick sync — PR #3611 is blocked by the smoke test on shard-7, failing nondeterministically. CI shows 2 failures in the last hour. Thinking we need a short-term policy: auto-skip extremely noisy smoke tests during presubmit after X reruns, with quarantine + tracking. opinions?

jamal: Can you paste the failing test name/logs?

alex: sure:
```
FAIL test_infer_pipeline_smoke[shard-7] -- AssertionError: expected 200 but got 503
  File "tests/smoke/test_infer_pipeline.py", line 42, in test_infer_pipeline_smoke
    assert resp.status == 200
```
I've seen this flip flakey when cluster is busy.

maya: we need to be careful about auto-skip. Skipping hides regressions. Proposal: add a quarantine label and only auto-skip in presubmit after the test fails > 3 times in the last 24h AND a human triage marks it as flaky. Nightly and canary still run the full suite.

rachel: +1 to quarantine label. Also call out owners so we don't ignore it. Maybe an automatic issue is created when a test hits the threshold.

jamal: I can prototype a GH action to apply a `quarantine/flaky` label based on rerun thresholds. It would look something like:
```yaml
on: [check_suite]
jobs:
  mark-flaky:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const fails = getRecentFailures('tests/smoke/test_infer_pipeline.py', 24)
            if (fails >= 3) github.issues.addLabels({ labels: ['quarantine/flaky'] })
```
This wouldn't skip automatically — just label and file. Then CI could read that label and *skip in presubmit* only if label present.

alex: that sounds like a safe middle ground. timeline? we need something short-term to unblock merges while keeping signal.

jamal: I can put up a draft action + CI hook PR today. Need a reviewer for the flow: who owns the smoke tests? @maya?

maya: I can be the owner for that test suite. I can triage flagged tests and confirm quarantine. Also we should track flaky tests in a small dashboard (could be just a spreadsheet for now).

ci-bot: CI rerun requested by alex: rerun 1/3 started (shard-7)

alex: thanks — if rerun passes we can merge after approvals. If rerun fails twice more, jamal will add the label automation.

rachel: small ask: can the policy require at least one assignee review before auto-skip takes effect? we shouldn't let label cause silent skips.

jamal: yes we can gate the skip on a `quarantine/approved` label that a human adds post-triage. Action will add `quarantine/candidate` and then owner (maya) flips to `quarantine/approved` to allow presubmit skip.

sre-oncall: fyi — if we start skipping smoke in presubmit, ensure canary retains it. alerting should pay attention to canary failures so we don't miss regressions. I'll add a small alert rule.

alex: action items:
- jamal: draft GH Action + CI hook PR (today)
- maya: triage current failing test + add owner + decide approved state
- rachel: confirm reviewer gating in the process
- sre-oncall: add canary alert for smoke failures

alex: pinging for quick eyes/ok to merge this plan? :eyes: (need to unblock a couple of PRs)

maya: ok from me.

rachel: ok, please include a short doc snippet so support knows why presubmit was skipped.

jamal: will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/pull/12 (draft)

alex: thanks everyone. I'll hold merge until the rerun completes and jamal's draft is posted.

alex: not merged yet, rerunning again.

ci-bot: CI rerun completed: 2/3 passed, overall status: succeeded

alex: merging now. Thanks for the quick coordination :rocket:
